author: BLT2122
title: Not fun anymore. PLEASE AVOID
content: I have played this game for about a year now. It is amazing how much it has changed. I realized within the first few months that it always left you just short of achieving more spins or completing tasks or quests. But it also would allow me to win sometimes and so I kept playing. I also used real money at the start as a way of getting real money rewards (choice of gift cards) in another promotional app. However, once I stopped using money, it became increasingly difficult to make any progress. I found myself constantly falling short of winning spins or unable to play at all, sometimes for days. My husband started playing after surgery and it became something we could do together on a team. He also used money at first to get real money rewards from another app. Turns out he was placed in another category of players where he is given ads (intermittently) that allow him to earn prizes that help him continue to play the game or make more progress than I can. I have never once had an ad even after writing customer service to make sure my account was working correctly. They told me some players get ads and others don’t. Even google said they try not to give ads to players who they think will continue to pay to play. This is common with these games. Well now here I am a year later and I almost never complete challenges, quests or even achieve little wins that allow me to continue to progress and play. My teammates (strangers from different places) state the same thing. We are some of the most dedicated and higher ranked players and it only gets worse. The game is recently even more focused on making money than allowing players to achieve what we have earned. It is also now recently changed to 18+ age range for a reason. It is addictive and basically gambling because you don’t ever “win” anymore. You have to play daily throughout the day to make any progress and even then, you never achieve anything. I haven’t spent money since last December and I came out on the positive side because I was only paying up until the promotional app rewards window ended. I will never waste real money on these kinds of games. There is a huge difference in paying for real video games that allow you to open up worlds or get tools to allow you to become a stronger player and win something. Coinmaster REQUIRES ZERO SKILL. There is nothing you can do to be better at it than others and you will never achieve anything in the game if their algorithm doesn’t let you. There is no luck either. It is a computer that has been programmed for you to constantly fall short so that you might pay them money. The best thing you can do for yourself is to avoid games like this and to find a different game that requires skill instead. I am deleting the game this week as well as my husband. We have decided to find fun games that actually challenge our brains and make it worth our time to play together. PLEASE AVOID!!!

author: djccjeisizdnxuebsohhd
title: Greedy, and prevents deletion
content:
I tried this game, as one of my other apps offered extra rewards for playing the sponsor games. It could be considered fun, but not because it's actually unique or interesting; it's only because it blasts you with constant small dopamine hits. And the amount of in-app purchase pop-ups is insane.

So, I wanted to delete it. I went into settings and requested deletion. However, it insisted I give my email. I did. I got an automated email saying that for me to delete the game, I needed to copy my player ID. But it didn't say what to do with it. So I copied my player ID, and then replied to the email with it. I then got an email saying, "Sorry, we can't pinpoint the problem. Here's an in-game gift to help you get back to the game action!" And I got a pretty big in-game gift.

The fact they are actively preventing people from leaving their game is very messed up, especially since the game is specifically made to be addicting, and it pushes purchases.

(I ended up deleting all data from the game in my phone settings.)
